CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT
            p.product_id,
            p.name,
            p.unit,
            COALESCE(SUM(il.quantity), 0) AS quantity_on_hand
        FROM products p
        LEFT JOIN inventory_log il ON il.product_id = p.product_id
        GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.unit

CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS WITH raw_balances AS (
            SELECT a.account_id, a.name, a.type, a.category, SUM(fl.amount) AS money_raw
            FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN financial_log fl ON fl.account_id = a.account_id
            GROUP BY a.account_id, a.name, a.type, a.category
            LIMIT -1 OFFSET 0
        )
        SELECT account_id, name, type, category, (
WITH
money_input AS (SELECT COALESCE(money_raw, 0.0) AS value),
money_text AS (
 SELECT value,
 CASE WHEN CAST(printf('%!.15g', value) AS REAL) = value THEN printf('%!.15g', value)
      WHEN CAST(printf('%!.16g', value) AS REAL) = value THEN printf('%!.16g', value)
      ELSE printf('%!.17g', value) END AS decimal_text
 FROM money_input
),
money_unsigned AS (
 SELECT value, CASE WHEN value < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS sign,
 CASE WHEN substr(decimal_text, 1, 1) = '-' THEN substr(decimal_text, 2)
      ELSE decimal_text END AS text FROM money_text
),
money_parts AS (
 SELECT value, sign,
 CASE WHEN instr(text, 'e') > 0 THEN substr(text, 1, instr(text, 'e') - 1) ELSE text END AS mantissa,
 CASE WHEN instr(text, 'e') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(text, instr(text, 'e') + 1) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END AS exponent
 FROM money_unsigned
),
money_digits AS (
 SELECT value, sign, replace(mantissa, '.', '') AS digits,
 CASE WHEN instr(mantissa, '.') > 0 THEN instr(mantissa, '.') - 1 ELSE length(mantissa) END + exponent + 2 AS cut
 FROM money_parts
),
money_split AS (
 SELECT value, sign,
 CASE WHEN cut <= 0 THEN '0'
      WHEN cut > 19 THEN 'overflow'
      ELSE substr(digits, 1, cut) || substr('0000000000000000000', 1, max(0, cut - length(digits))) END AS kept,
 CASE WHEN cut < 0 THEN 0
      WHEN substr(digits, cut + 1, 1) >= '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS carry
 FROM money_digits
),
money_integer AS (
 SELECT value, sign, kept, carry, ltrim(kept, '0') AS significant FROM money_split
)
SELECT CASE
 WHEN kept = 'overflow' OR length(significant) > 19
      OR (length(significant) = 19 AND significant >= '9223372036854775807') THEN value
 ELSE (CAST(kept AS INTEGER) + carry) * sign / 100.0 END
FROM money_integer
) AS balance FROM raw_balances

CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT
            e.event_id,
            e.raw_liters,
            e.fat_percentage,
            e.lr_reading,
            e.milk_rate_used,
            e.delivery_fee_used,
            e.ts_standard_used,
            (0.25 * e.lr_reading) + (0.22 * e.fat_percentage) + 0.72 AS expected_snf_percentage,
            e.fat_percentage + ((0.25 * e.lr_reading) + (0.22 * e.fat_percentage) + 0.72) AS expected_ts_percentage,
            e.raw_liters * (
                (
                    e.fat_percentage +
                    ((0.25 * e.lr_reading) + (0.22 * e.fat_percentage) + 0.72)
                ) / e.ts_standard_used
            ) AS expected_adjusted_liters,
            (
                e.raw_liters * (
                    (
                        e.fat_percentage +
                        ((0.25 * e.lr_reading) + (0.22 * e.fat_percentage) + 0.72)
                    ) / e.ts_standard_used
                ) * e.milk_rate_used
            ) + (e.raw_liters * e.delivery_fee_used) AS expected_amount_owed
        FROM events e
        WHERE e.event_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT'

CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT
            e.event_id,
            e.sale_quantity,
            e.sale_value,
            e.unit_rate,
            e.surcharge_applied,
            ROUND(e.sale_quantity * e.unit_rate, 2) AS expected_value_from_quantity,
            ROUND(e.sale_value / e.unit_rate, 4) AS expected_quantity_from_value,
            ROUND(e.sale_value + e.surcharge_applied, 2) AS expected_total
        FROM events e
        WHERE e.event_type = 'SALE'
